name: Canyon Ranch Woodside
insider_take: A wellness sanctuary nestled in the redwood forests of Silicon Valley, where tech executives decompress and reconnect with nature.
whats_special: Canyon Ranch Woodside sits on 16 pristine acres surrounded by towering redwoods, making it the only luxury wellness resort in the San Francisco Bay Area. The property features a world-class spa, fitness facilities, and healthy gourmet cuisine, all while being just 30 minutes from downtown San Francisco. Its location in Woodside places you among some of the most expensive real estate in America, where tech billionaires and celebrities call home.
pro_tip: Book treatments early in your stay - the spa's signature redwood forest meditation walks and outdoor fitness classes fill up quickly, especially on weekends when locals visit for day packages.
dont_miss: The sunrise yoga sessions on the outdoor deck overlooking the redwood canopy, and the resort's farm-to-table dining experience featuring ingredients from local Woodside farms. Take advantage of the guided nature hikes through nearby Huddart Park and the historic Filoli Estate, just minutes away.
pros: World-class wellness and spa programs with comprehensive health assessments
Stunning Silicon Valley location surrounded by redwood forests
All-inclusive experience with healthy gourmet cuisine and fitness activities
Expert-led wellness classes and personalized health consultations
cons: Premium pricing for specialized wellness programs
